canonical_name: No Privacy and Protection of PII
description: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information is not ensured as required.
applicability: Applies when an organization does not identify and meet privacy and PII protection requirements applicable to the organization, including compliance with privacy laws, data subject rights, consent management, and cross-border data transfer controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Review privacy policies and procedures, verify PII inventory and data mapping, check consent management processes, assess data subject rights procedures, examine data protection impact assessments, verify cross-border transfer mechanisms, review privacy training and awareness.
